title: Codex turn usage report
incomplete: Partial evidence, not a complete total
card_note: Parent usage is the counter difference from start to snapshot; subagents use saved request records in this window, deduplicated by request. Data may be delayed or incomplete and excludes tools and final text after this snapshot. This is not subscription quota or billing. Unknown is not zero; Stop settlement is saved separately and does not rewrite this snapshot.
child_unavailable: Subagent data is incomplete; unknown is not zero
context_missing: No settings observed for this turn in the tail; current preferences are not substituted.
settings_heading: This turn's settings (tail observations, not token allocation)
pending: Pending: no usable Stop snapshot exists for this turn yet. This is not a completed usage report.
pending_note: Local code fills this page at turn end. Disabling reports, interruption, the duration threshold or a hook failure can leave it pending. Missing numbers do not mean zero usage.
failed: Automatic usage report could not complete; budget rules and Task state are unaffected.
note_stop: This is a user-turn Stop snapshot, not proof the whole Task is complete; another hook may continue it.
note_usage: Parent usage uses counter differences; subagents use saved per-request records in this window. Both may lag and are not quota percentages or billing.
note_counter: Counter resets or source changes remain unknown. Tail scans are bounded and cannot prove there were no unobserved resets.
note_subsets: Input includes cached tokens and output includes reasoning; subsets are not added again. Observed zero does not mean a free turn.
note_scope: Only this Task and linked descendants are included. Request timestamps determine the window; subagent lifetime totals are not added again.
note_children: Unfinished children, missing request records and scan limits remain incomplete. Reporting does not wait, force-stop or request continuation.
note_render: Fixed local Python rendering calls no model, requests no continuation and edits neither the assistant's answer nor source conversations.
